g.aria-label: The Log-Derivative Trick: Turning ∇_θ E[R] into a Sampleable Expectation
∇_θ J(θ) = ∑_τ [∇_θ P(τ; θ)] · R(τ) (cannot sample ∇_θ P)
2. Apply identity ∇_θ P = P · ∇_θ log P:
∇_θ J(θ) = ∑_τ P(τ; θ) · [R(τ) ∇_θ log P(τ; θ)]
3. Rewrite as expectation over τ ~ P(·; θ):
∇_θ J(θ) = E_τ ~ P[ R(τ) ∑_t=0^T−1 ∇_θ log π_θ(a_t | s_t) ]
